text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Serving runtime detected repeated container restarts (12 in 5m) on cluster serving-prod-us-west-2. Symptom: GPU OOM during prefill (long prompts). Pager -> SRE-oncall.

mira: oncall here, I'm seeing OOMs correlated with prefill token spikes from a few customers, long-context requests (~6k+ tokens).

devon: ack. grabbing logs now. which node?

mira: pod serving-runtime-7f8b9 on ip-10-0-5-12. logs show CUDA OOM and OOM killer surrounding prefill phase.

devon: paste of tail logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] model_prefill: allocating KV cache 1.2GB
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] kernel panic? container killed (OOM)
[2026-03-17T02:14:04Z] pod restarted (exitCode=137)
```

priya: this matches the perf dashboard spike — prefill token distribution went up 4x for that route. customer bump from an aggregator sending long transcripts.

mira: mitigation options I can push now: 1) set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=2048 on the model route, 2) enable prefix_trim for that route, 3) route heavy requests to small-quant fallback, 4) cordon/drain the noisy node to stop noisy-neighbor restarts. which do we want first?

devon: do 1 + 3 immediately (env change + fallback). I'll cordon the node if we keep seeing restarts.

mira: applying env change to the deployment:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/serving-runtime PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=2048 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/serving-runtime
```

mira: also toggled route fallback -> small-quant (traffic split 90/10 to start).

devon: cordoning node now to stop further restarts as a safety:
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12
kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

mira: quick note on customer impact: initial estimate ~3% of inference requests returned 5xx during spike window (02:12-02:18 UTC). Affected customers: acct-314, acct-992 (high-volume transcript ingest).

cs-taylor: copying in CS template, we'll notify those accounts with the short update + ETA once mitigation stabilizes.

devon: after env change + fallback we saw restart rate drop dramatically. error rate now ~0.6% and prefill OOM logs reduced.

priya: confirmed on dashboard: token distribution back to baseline for the route. request latency stabilized.

mira: leaving a temporary guardrail: added a gating rule on the gateway to reject prefill > 8k tokens with 429 and link to best-practices. will remove when we have a better long-term fix.

raj: thanks — I'm taking handoff in ~40m. please leave notes on timeline + steps taken. any open actions?

mira: open action: eng-runtime to investigate persistent KV cache fragmentation and add more robust eviction for prefill phase (assign to devon). also product to contact the aggregator about batching/shortening prompts.

devon: filing follow-up issue (#INC-2026-prefill-kv-frag). attaching logs and heap profiles.

cs-taylor: I'll send customer updates now (brief + mitigation steps).

mira: ok handing off to @raj. if anything flares before morning, page the SRE rotation. otherwise we'll regroup in the post-incident review. :thumbsup:
